Key.English: CHOOSE YOUR GAME MODE AND FACTIONS

SELECT swaps a role, EDIT changes a vehicle role's list, CLEAR empties it. <t color='#ffd133'>Yellow</t> is a fallback substitute the faction still fields; <t color='#ff5959'>red</t> is a vanilla stand-in or a role it does not field. SELECT swaps a role, EDIT changes a vehicle role's list, CLEAR empties it. <t color='#ffd133'>Yellow</t> is a fallback substitute the faction still fields; <t color='#ff5959'>red</t> is a vanilla stand-in or a role it does not field. Place your HQ.

Place your HQ.

放置你的总部。

Key.Chinesesimp: 返回，重新选择阵营与总部位置。

Key.English: Continue? This action will lock in your factions.

Each spawn picks a random vehicle from the list. The top row is the main vehicle. Auto-detected vehicles are derived from it.
ADD: add the previewed vehicle.
REMOVE: remove the selected vehicle.

RESET: undo all changes.
Key.English:
Each spawn picks a random vehicle from the list. The top row is the main vehicle. Auto-detected vehicles are derived from it.
ADD: add the previewed vehicle.
REMOVE: remove the selected vehicle.
MAKE MAIN: move the selected vehicle to the top.
RESET: undo all changes.
Key.Chinesesimp:
每次生成都会从列表中随机选取一辆载具。首行为主载具，自动检测的载具由其推导而来。

移除：移除所选载具。
设为主要：将所选载具移到首行。
重置：撤销所有更改。

Key.Original: Type to narrow the class list. Matches the display name or the classname.
Key.English: Type to narrow the class list. Matches the display name or the classname.
Key.Chinesesimp: 输入以缩小类别列表范围，匹配显示名称或类名。

Key.English: Type to narrow the faction list. Matches the faction name.

Key.English: OPFOR hold the island in zones. Take them one at a time and spend what you earn on the force that takes the next.

Key.English: OPFOR outnumber and outgun you from the start. Fewer supports, heavier enemy forces, and every weapon and supply crate has to be earned. By you.

Key.Original: Fight back infected hordes or demons. Build up a survivor base, survive, and get off the island. Needs the Ravage or WBK mod.
Key.English: Fight back infected hordes or demons. Build up a survivor base, survive, and get off the island. Needs the Ravage or WBK mod.

Key.English: Generates a corresponding number of enemy zones. (Note: The greater the number of enemy zones, the higher the chance of lag and overlapping zone positions.)

Key.English: Define the location of Random Zones

Key.English: Set the multiplier applied to the CP and AP payout for each mission.

Key.English: Before generating the campaign with non-default parameters, make sure that the map you are playing on can host all the zones. Otherwise DUWS_T may not be able to generate the zones.

Key.English: When enabled, every non-military building destroyed anywhere on the map raises support costs for both sides. Flatten enough of it and the campaign is lost.
Key.Chinesesimp: 启用后，地图上任何非军事建筑被摧毁都会提高双方的支援费用。夷平的建筑足够多时，战役将失败。

Key.Original: Too many vehicles on the helipad. Only one vehicle allowed at a time.
Key.English: Too many vehicles on the helipad. Only one vehicle allowed at a time.
Key.Chinesesimp: 停机坪上载具过多，同一时间只允许一辆载具。

Key.Original: Repaired, rearmed and refueled. Cost: %1 CP.
Key.English: Repaired, rearmed and refueled. Cost: %1 CP.
Key.Chinesesimp: 已维修、补充弹药并加油。费用：%1 CP。

Key.German: Die Zeit wurde 3 Stunden vorgespult und alle Teammitglieder wurden vollständig geheilt
Key.Spanish: El juego ha avanzado 3 horas. TODAS las unidades han sido completamente curadas
Key.Chinesesimp: 游戏时间已推进 3 小时。
Key.Original: Game time has advanced by 3 hrs.
Key.English: Game time has advanced by 3 hrs.

Key.Original: No kits have been scanned yet.
Key.English: No kits have been scanned yet.

Key.Original: Only the host (GM, seat 1) can order rest and heal.\n\nCurrently occupied by: %1.
Key.English: Only the host (GM, seat 1) can order rest and heal.\n\nCurrently occupied by: %1.
Key.Chinesesimp: 只有主机（GM，1 号席位）可以下令休整。\n\n当前占用者：%1。

Key.Original: No base guard found to copy from. Keeping your default loadout.
Key.English: No base guard found to copy from. Keeping your default loadout.
Key.Chinesesimp: 未找到可复制装备的基地警卫，保留你的默认装备。
[军械库] 已移除 %1 件受限物品。

Key.German: Das Arsenal-System von DUWS_X wurde in DUWS_T vollständig überarbeitet — es unterstützt nun alle von ALIVE erstellten Fraktionen! Das bedeutet, es gibt keine verschwindenden Zielgeräte, Schalldämpfer, Brillen etc. mehr. Speichern und Laden des Restricted Arsenal wurde deaktiviert. Passe deine Ausrüstung sorgfältig an.
Key.Spanish: El sistema de arsenal de DUWS_X ha sido completamente rehecho en DUWS_T — ¡ahora es compatible con todas las facciones creadas con ALIVE! Esto significa que no habrá más miras, silenciadores, gafas u otros objetos que desaparezcan. Se ha desactivado el guardado y carga del Restricted Arsenal. Ajusta tu equipamiento con cuidado.
Key.Chinesesimp: 军械库中包含任务检测到的所有阵营的装备，瞄具、消音器等配件会保留在武器上。只有军械库设为“完整”时，才能保存和加载配装。
Key.Original: The arsenal holds gear from every faction the mission detected, and attachments such as scopes and suppressors stay on your weapon. You can only save and load loadouts when the arsenal is set to Full.
Key.English: The arsenal holds gear from every faction the mission detected, and attachments such as scopes and suppressors stay on your weapon. You can only save and load loadouts when the arsenal is set to Full.

Key.Spanish: Los objetos clave de esta misión incluyen un arsenal completo de un solo uso. ¡No olvides usarlos!
Key.German: Die Schlüsselgegenstände dieser Mission haben ein einmaliges Vollarsenal – vergiss nicht, es zu nutzen!
Key.Chinesesimp: 缴获的武器与装备已加入你的军械库
Key.Original: Captured weapons and gear added to your arsenal
Key.English: Captured weapons and gear added to your arsenal

Key.Original: Blend into the population. Needs civilian clothing, no weapons or NVGs, on foot or in a civilian vehicle. Suspicion builds while enemies watch you, faster near bodies and enemy positions. Arming up or changing gear breaks cover.
Key.English: Blend into the population. Needs civilian clothing, no weapons or NVGs, on foot or in a civilian vehicle. Suspicion builds while enemies watch you, faster near bodies and enemy positions. Arming up or changing gear breaks cover.
Key.Chinesesimp: 融入平民之中。需要穿着平民服装，不携带武器或夜视仪，徒步或乘坐平民载具。当敌人注视你时，可疑度会上升，靠近尸体与敌方据点时上升更快。携带武器或更换装备会暴露身份。

Key.Original: Not available in this campaign - there is no civilian population to blend into.
Key.English: Not available in this campaign - there is no civilian population to blend into.
Key.Chinesesimp: 本战役不可用——没有可供融入的平民人口。

Key.Original: Pass as an enemy soldier. Needs a looted enemy uniform, worn. Suspicion builds while enemies watch you, and starts higher for each item the enemy does not issue. Attacking in sight breaks cover.
Key.English: Pass as an enemy soldier. Needs a looted enemy uniform, worn. Suspicion builds while enemies watch you, and starts higher for each item the enemy does not issue. Attacking in sight breaks cover.
Key.Chinesesimp: 伪装成敌方士兵。需要穿着缴获的敌方军服。当敌人注视你时，可疑度会上升，每有一件非敌方制式装备，起始可疑度就更高。在被目睹的情况下攻击会暴露身份。

Key.Original: Equipping a weapon, NVGs or any non-civilian gear breaks the disguise.
Key.English: Equipping a weapon, NVGs or any non-civilian gear breaks the disguise.
Key.Chinesesimp: 携带武器、夜视仪或任何非平民装备都会暴露伪装。

Key.Original: Entering a non-civilian vehicle breaks the disguise.
Key.English: Entering a non-civilian vehicle breaks the disguise.
Key.Chinesesimp: 进入非平民载具会暴露伪装。

Key.Original: Throwing anything or placing a charge while seen breaks the disguise.
Key.English: Throwing anything or placing a charge while seen breaks the disguise.
Key.Chinesesimp: 在被目睹的情况下投掷物品或安放炸药会暴露伪装。

Key.Original: Being seen inside an enemy position breaks the disguise.
Key.English: Being seen inside an enemy position breaks the disguise.
Key.Chinesesimp: 在敌方据点内被目睹会暴露伪装。

Key.Original: Suspicion rises while the enemy watches you, faster up close, while crouched or prone, near enemy positions and near bodies.
Key.English: Suspicion rises while the enemy watches you, faster up close, while crouched or prone, near enemy positions and near bodies.
Key.Chinesesimp: 当敌人注视你时，可疑度会上升；距离越近、蹲下或匍匐时、靠近敌方据点或尸体时，上升更快。

Key.Original: Current suspicion value is %1 of 100 (lower is better), based on your gear:
Key.English: Current suspicion value is %1 of 100 (lower is better), based on your gear:
Key.Chinesesimp: 根据你的装备，当前可疑度为 %1/100（数值越低越好）：
你的装备并无可疑之处。

Key.Original: Suspicion rises while the enemy watches you, faster up close, while crouched or prone and near bodies.
Key.English: Suspicion rises while the enemy watches you, faster up close, while crouched or prone and near bodies.
Key.Chinesesimp: 当敌人注视你时，可疑度会上升；距离越近、蹲下或匍匐时、靠近尸体时，上升更快。

Key.Original: Attacking while seen breaks the disguise.
Key.English: Attacking while seen breaks the disguise.
Key.Chinesesimp: 在被目睹的情况下攻击会暴露伪装。

Key.Original: Taking off the enemy uniform ends the disguise.
Key.English: Taking off the enemy uniform ends the disguise.
Key.Chinesesimp: 脱下敌方军服会结束伪装。
伪装冷却：剩余 %1 分 %2 秒

Key.Original: You are getting too close to an enemy position.
Key.English: You are getting too close to an enemy position.

Key.Original: You are now disguised as a civilian.
Key.English: You are now disguised as a civilian.

Key.Original: I'm watching you. Go back the way you came.
Key.English: I'm watching you. Go back the way you came.

Key.Original: Halt. This is a restricted area. Turn around.
Key.English: Halt. This is a restricted area. Turn around.
Key.Chinesesimp: 站住，这里是限制区域，转身离开。

Key.Original: This area is closed to civilians. Leave now.
Key.English: This area is closed to civilians. Leave now.
Key.Chinesesimp: 此区域禁止平民进入，立刻离开。

Key.Original: You are not cleared to be here. Move back.
Key.English: You are not cleared to be here. Move back.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你没有权限进入此地，后退。

Key.Original: Civilian, this is a military zone. Clear the area.
Key.English: Civilian, this is a military zone. Clear the area.
Key.Chinesesimp: 平民，这里是军事区域，离开此地。

Key.Original: Do not come any closer. Turn back now.
Key.English: Do not come any closer. Turn back now.

Key.Original: Move along. You cannot be here.
Key.English: Move along. You cannot be here.

Key.Original: This area is off limits. Clear off.
Key.English: This area is off limits. Clear off.

Key.Original: Spotted too close to an enemy position.
Key.English: Spotted too close to an enemy position.
Key.Chinesesimp: 在敌方据点附近被发现。

Key.Original: Cannot disguise: Not available in this scenario.
Key.English: Cannot disguise: Not available in this scenario.
Key.Chinesesimp: 无法伪装：本场景不可用。

Key.Original: Cannot disguise: There is no civilian population to blend into.
Key.English: Cannot disguise: There is no civilian population to blend into.
Key.Chinesesimp: 无法伪装：没有可供融入的平民人口。

Key.Original: Cannot disguise: You are in a non-civilian vehicle.
Key.English: Cannot disguise: You are in a non-civilian vehicle.
Key.Chinesesimp: 无法伪装：你正处于非平民载具中。

Key.Original: Cannot disguise: You are carrying a weapon.
Key.English: Cannot disguise: You are carrying a weapon.
Key.Chinesesimp: 无法伪装：你正携带武器。

Key.Original: Cannot disguise: You are carrying night vision goggles.
Key.English: Cannot disguise: You are carrying night vision goggles.
Key.Chinesesimp: 无法伪装：你正携带夜视仪。

Key.Original: Cannot disguise: You aren't wearing any clothing.
Key.English: Cannot disguise: You aren't wearing any clothing.
Key.Chinesesimp: 无法伪装：你没有穿任何服装。

Key.Original: Cannot disguise: You are wearing a military uniform.
Key.English: Cannot disguise: You are wearing a military uniform.
Key.Chinesesimp: 无法伪装：你正穿着军服。

Key.Original: Cannot disguise: You are wearing a military vest.
Key.English: Cannot disguise: You are wearing a military vest.
Key.Chinesesimp: 无法伪装：你正穿着战术背心。

Key.Original: Cannot disguise: You are wearing military headgear.
Key.English: Cannot disguise: You are wearing military headgear.
Key.Chinesesimp: 无法伪装：你正戴着军用头饰。

Key.Original: Cannot disguise: You are carrying a military backpack.
Key.English: Cannot disguise: You are carrying a military backpack.
Key.Chinesesimp: 无法伪装：你正背着军用背包。

Key.Original: Cannot disguise while an enemy can see you.
Key.English: Cannot disguise while an enemy can see you.
Key.Chinesesimp: 敌人能看见你时无法伪装。

Key.Original: Cannot disguise while enemies are too close.
Key.English: Cannot disguise while enemies are too close.

Key.Original: Cannot disguise while too close to an enemy position.
Key.English: Cannot disguise while too close to an enemy position.
Key.Chinesesimp: 过于靠近敌方据点时无法伪装。

Key.Original: Cannot disguise: Enemy issue is not known yet. Try again in a minute.
Key.English: Cannot disguise: Enemy issue is not known yet. Try again in a minute.
Key.Chinesesimp: 无法伪装：尚未确定敌方制式装备，一分钟后再试。

Key.Original: Cannot disguise: You are not wearing an enemy uniform.
Key.English: Cannot disguise: You are not wearing an enemy uniform.
Key.Chinesesimp: 无法伪装：你没有穿着敌方军服。

Key.Original: You are now disguised as an OPFOR. Suspicion starts at %1 of 100.
Key.English: You are now disguised as an OPFOR. Suspicion starts at %1 of 100.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你已伪装成 OPFOR。初始可疑度为 %1/100。

Key.Original: Disguise off: You are no longer in an enemy uniform.
Key.English: Disguise off: You are no longer in an enemy uniform.
Key.Chinesesimp: 伪装已解除：你不再穿着敌方军服。

Key.Original: Partisan squad ready. Click on the map to select a deployment location.
Key.English: Partisan squad ready. Click on the map to select a deployment location.
Key.Chinesesimp: 游击队小队已就绪，在地图上点击以选择部署位置。
Key.Chinese: 游击队准备好了，点击地图选择部署位置。

Key.Chinesesimp: 冷却中：剩余 %1 分 %2 秒

Key.Original: %1 PMC operators hired and joined your squad.
Key.English: %1 PMC operators hired and joined your squad.
Key.Chinesesimp: 已雇佣 %1 名 PMC 作战人员并加入你的小队。

Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, be advised. We have made contact with local military contractors. You now have external support.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, be advised. We have made contact with local military contractors. You now have external support.
Key.Chinesesimp: Alpha 1-1，注意，我们已与当地军事承包商取得联系，你现在拥有外部支援。

Key.Original: %1 PMC operators are now under your command. Their gear varies from man to man. You can hire again in 15 minutes.
Key.English: %1 PMC operators are now under your command. Their gear varies from man to man. You can hire again in 15 minutes.
Key.Chinesesimp: %1 名 PMC 作战人员现已归你指挥，他们的装备因人而异。你可以在 15 分钟后再次雇佣。
冷却中：剩余 %1 分 %2 秒

Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, %1 local volunteers have joined your squad.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, %1 local volunteers have joined your squad.
Key.Chinesesimp: Alpha 1-1，%1 名当地志愿者已加入你的小队。

Key.Original: %1 partisans are now under your command. Their gear is whatever they could find. You can hire again in 30 minutes.
Key.English: %1 partisans are now under your command. Their gear is whatever they could find. You can hire again in 30 minutes.
Key.Chinesesimp: %1 名游击队员现已归你指挥，他们的装备是能找到什么就用什么。你可以在 30 分钟后再次雇佣。

Key.Original: You are already placing a partisan squad.
Key.English: You are already placing a partisan squad.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你已经在部署一支游击队小队。

Key.Original: Click on the map to deploy your partisans. You cannot close the map until you choose a location.
Key.English: Click on the map to deploy your partisans. You cannot close the map until you choose a location.
Key.Chinesesimp: 在地图上点击以部署你的游击队。在选择位置之前，你无法关闭地图。

Key.Original: One of our vehicles is damaged. Do you have a toolkit, or know where we can find one? We'll pay.
Key.English: One of our vehicles is damaged. Do you have a toolkit, or know where we can find one? We'll pay.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我们有一辆载具损坏了。你有工具包吗，或者知道哪里能找到？我们会付钱。

Key.Original: Take it. It's the only one we have.
Key.English: Take it. It's the only one we have.
Key.Chinesesimp: 拿去吧，这是我们唯一的一个。

Key.Original: We've taken casualties. Can you spare any medical supplies? We'll pay for them.
Key.English: We've taken casualties. Can you spare any medical supplies? We'll pay for them.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我们有人受伤了，你能匀一些医疗物资给我们吗？我们会付钱。

Key.Original: We've barely enough for our own. I can't help you.
Key.English: We've barely enough for our own. I can't help you.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我们自己都快不够用了，帮不了你。

Key.Original: Take it. It's not much, but it's what we have.
Key.English: Take it. It's not much, but it's what we have.
Key.Chinesesimp: 拿去吧，不多，但这是我们仅有的。

Key.German: ...? Was habe ich getan?? (hebt langsam die Hände)

Key.Original: Found document: %1. Analyse intel at HQ.
Key.English: Found document: %1. Analyse intel at HQ.
Key.German: Heh... du Bastard... Hey! Ich habe etwas Interessantes gefunden!
Key.Spanish: Je... hijo de puta... Oye! He encontrado algo interesante!
Key.Chinesesimp: 找到文件：%1。前往总部分析情报。

Key.German: Das ist verdammter Krieg, Bruder... du brauchst das nicht.
Key.Spanish: Es una puta guerra, hermano... no necesitas esto.

Key.Chinesesimp: 当地人递给你 %1 现金。
物品栏已满。\n\n已掉落在你脚下：

Key.Original: Have you seen any enemy movement around here? We'll pay for anything useful.
Key.English: Have you seen any enemy movement around here? We'll pay for anything useful.
Key.German: Hallo! Hast du die Position des feindlichen Abschaums gesehen? (zieht einen Stapel lokaler Geldscheine heraus)
Key.Spanish: ¡Hola! ¿Has visto la ubicación de los enemigos escoria? (saca un montón de dinero local)
Key.Chinesesimp: 你在附近见过敌军动向吗？只要有用，我们就付钱。

Key.Original: Yes, there's a few I know of.
Key.English: Yes, there's a few I know of.
Key.German: Äh... Ich weiß! Tritt diesen Abschaum richtig in den Arsch! Sie sind genau hier auf der Karte...(spricht, während er die Geldscheine nimmt)
Key.Spanish: Eh... ¡Lo sé! ¡Dales una buena paliza a esos escoria! Están justo aquí en el mapa...(hablando mientras coge los billetes)

Key.Original: The civilian has joined your squad. Take them back to HQ for a reward. They may panic and break formation, so repeat the regroup command to keep them in line.
Key.English: The civilian has joined your squad. Take them back to HQ for a reward. They may panic and break formation, so repeat the regroup command to keep them in line.
Key.Chinesesimp: 该平民已加入你的小队。带他们返回总部即可获得奖励。他们可能会恐慌并脱离队形，重复集合指令可让他们归队。

Key.Original: This civilian has already been approached.
Key.English: This civilian has already been approached.

Key.Original: Each evacuated civilian grants your team %1 CP.
Key.English: Each evacuated civilian grants your team %1 CP.
Key.Chinesesimp: 每撤离一名平民，你的小队获得 %1 CP。

Key.German: Hey! Es ist hier gefährlich. Wir bringen dich an einen sicheren Ort!
Key.Spanish: ¡Oye! Es peligroso aquí. Te llevaremos a un lugar seguro!
Key.Chinesesimp: 这里不安全，我们带你去安全的地方。
Key.Original: It's not safe here. We'll get you to safety.
Key.English: It's not safe here. We'll get you to safety.

Key.German: Äh... okay! Ich folge euch! Alle sind durchgeknallt...
Key.Spanish: Eh... ¡vale! ¡Os seguiré! Todo el mundo se ha vuelto loco...
Key.Chinesesimp: 呃……好吧！我跟你走！所有人都疯了……
Key.Original: Uh... okay! I'll follow you! Everyone's gone crazy...
Key.English: Uh... okay! I'll follow you! Everyone's gone crazy...

Key.German: Das ist es. Ein Evakuierungshubschrauber wird euch gleich abholen.
Key.Spanish: Aquí es. Un helicóptero de evacuación os recogerá en breve.
Key.Chinesesimp: 就是这里，撤离直升机很快就会来接你。
Key.Original: This is it. An evacuation helicopter will pick you up shortly.
Key.English: This is it. An evacuation helicopter will pick you up shortly.

Key.German: Ich glaube euch nicht... Ihr seht nicht wie gute Menschen aus...
Key.Spanish: No os creo... No parecéis gente buena...
Key.Chinesesimp: 我不相信你们这些人……你们看起来不像好人……
Key.Original: I don't trust your lot... You don't look like good people to me...
Key.English: I don't trust your lot... You don't look like good people to me...

Key.German: Ich kann nicht glauben, dass es Idioten gibt, die freiwillig an diesem gefährlichen Ort bleiben...
Key.Spanish: No puedo creer que haya idiotas que se queden voluntariamente en este lugar peligroso...
Key.Chinesesimp: 真难相信还有人愿意留在这么危险的地方……
Key.Original: Hard to believe anyone would stay in a place this dangerous...
Key.English: Hard to believe anyone would stay in a place this dangerous...

Key.Spanish: Action Squad, aquí "Overlord". Infección confirmada en tu zona. Se te permite abrir fuego contra los infectados a voluntad. Pero ten cuidado — la posibilidad de supervivientes no ha sido descartada.
Key.German: Action Squad, hier ist "Overlord". Infektion in Ihrem Gebiet bestätigt. Freies Feuer auf Infizierte genehmigt. Seien Sie vorsichtig — die Möglichkeit von Überlebenden ist nicht ausgeschlossen.
Key.Chinesesimp: Alpha 1-1，你所在区域确认发生感染。你可自由交战感染者，但保持警惕，可能仍有幸存者。
Key.Original: Alpha 1-1. Infection confirmed in your area. You're cleared to engage the infected at will, but stay sharp: there may still be survivors.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1. Infection confirmed in your area. You're cleared to engage the infected at will, but stay sharp: there may still be survivors.

Key.Original: Locals hear things. Whether they tell you depends on what this town thinks of you.
Key.English: Locals hear things. Whether they tell you depends on what this town thinks of you.
Key.Chinesesimp: 当地人会听到些风声，是否告诉你取决于这座城镇对你的看法。

Key.Original: A medikit and three dressings, left at their feet.
Key.English: A medikit and three dressings, left at their feet.
Key.Chinesesimp: 一个医疗包和三条绷带，留在他们脚下。

Key.Original: A toolkit, left at their feet.
Key.English: A toolkit, left at their feet.
Key.Chinesesimp: 一个工具包，留在他们脚下。

Key.Original: Order them to the ground at gunpoint, then search them. The town will hear about it.
Key.English: Order them to the ground at gunpoint, then search them. The town will hear about it.
Key.Chinesesimp: 用枪指着他们，命令其趴下，然后进行搜索。城镇会得知此事。

Key.Original: Nothing's free around here. %1 cash and it's yours, otherwise we're done.
Key.English: Nothing's free around here. %1 cash and it's yours, otherwise we're done.
Key.Chinesesimp: 这里没有免费的东西，给 %1 现金就是你的了，不然免谈。

Key.Original: The trader refuses to deal with you while %1 is hostile towards you.
Key.English: The trader refuses to deal with you while %1 is hostile towards you.
Key.Chinesesimp: 在 %1 对你敌对期间，商人拒绝与你交易。

Key.Original: Take a look. I've got what you need.
Key.English: Take a look. I've got what you need.
Key.Chinesesimp: 看看吧，我这儿有你需要的东西。

Key.Original: You do not have enough money.
Key.English: You do not have enough money.

Key.Original: Ask if they need help. A job pays CP, money or the town's goodwill.
Key.English: Ask if they need help. A job pays CP, money or the town's goodwill.
Key.Chinesesimp: 询问对方是否需要帮助。任务会以 CP、现金或城镇好感度作为报酬。

Key.Original: No, nothing right now. Thank you anyway.
Key.English: No, nothing right now. Thank you anyway.
Key.Chinesesimp: 不用，暂时没什么。不过还是谢谢你。

Key.Original: The locals need help with a local bandit group who have been taking what they want from them. Destroy the camp and then report back to the local.
Key.English: The locals need help with a local bandit group who have been taking what they want from them. Destroy the camp and then report back to the local.
Key.Chinesesimp: 当地居民需要帮助对付一伙一直抢夺他们财物的强盗。摧毁营地，然后向当地居民回报。

Key.Original: We need help with some bandits camping just outside of town. They loot and rob whenever they please. If you could get rid of them, that would help us greatly.
Key.English: We need help with some bandits camping just outside of town. They loot and rob whenever they please. If you could get rid of them, that would help us greatly.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我们需要帮忙对付一些在城镇外扎营的强盗。他们想抢就抢，想偷就偷。如果你能除掉他们，对我们帮助很大。

Key.Original: A local needs help recovering their car from a bandit group who stole it. Drive the car back to its owner and then report back to them.
Key.English: A local needs help recovering their car from a bandit group who stole it. Drive the car back to its owner and then report back to them.
Key.Chinesesimp: 一名当地居民的汽车被一伙强盗偷走，需要帮忙找回。把车开回还给车主，然后向他们回报。

Key.Original: Some bandits stole my car and took it to their camp outside of town. If you could bring it back to me, I'd be very grateful.
Key.English: Some bandits stole my car and took it to their camp outside of town. If you could bring it back to me, I'd be very grateful.
Key.Chinesesimp: 一些强盗偷走了我的车，把它弄到了城镇外的营地里。如果你能帮我把它带回来，我会非常感激。

Key.Original: Thank you. Here, have this. It's not much, but it's what I owe you.
Key.English: Thank you. Here, have this. It's not much, but it's what I owe you.
Key.Chinesesimp: 谢谢你。拿着这个吧。不多，但这是我欠你的。

Key.Original: Fine. I'll manage on my own.
Key.English: Fine. I'll manage on my own.

Key.Chinesesimp: 奖励：%1 CP，%2 现金，+%3 城镇声望

Key.Original: I understand. Stay safe out there.
Key.English: I understand. Stay safe out there.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我理解。你在外面注意安全。
奖励：%1 CP，+%2 城镇声望

Key.Original: The locals need help raising %1 money to rebuild part of their town and pay for supplies. Pool what money you can, and provide it to the locals. They will be grateful.
Key.English: The locals need help raising %1 money to rebuild part of their town and pay for supplies. Pool what money you can, and provide it to the locals. They will be grateful.
Key.Chinesesimp: 当地居民需要帮助筹集 %1 现金，用于重建部分城镇并购买补给。尽你所能凑集资金交给他们，他们会心怀感激。

Key.Original: The war has left part of our town in ruins, and we're %1 money short of what we need to rebuild and buy supplies. If you could spare anything at all, it would help us greatly.
Key.English: The war has left part of our town in ruins, and we're %1 money short of what we need to rebuild and buy supplies. If you could spare anything at all, it would help us greatly.
Key.Chinesesimp: 战争让我们城镇的一部分沦为废墟，我们还缺 %1 现金才能凑够重建和购买补给所需的资金。如果你能提供任何帮助，对我们都大有裨益。

Key.Original: Thank you. That makes %1 of the %2 we need.
Key.English: Thank you. That makes %1 of the %2 we need.
Key.Chinesesimp: 谢谢你。这样我们已筹到所需 %2 中的 %1 了。

Key.Original: Thank you. I won't forget what you've done for us.
Key.English: Thank you. I won't forget what you've done for us.
Key.Chinesesimp: 谢谢你。我不会忘记你为我们做的一切。
已筹：%2 中的 %1 现金

Key.Original: There's an old minefield just outside town, and a few mines are still in the ground. No one dares farm there. If you could clear what's left, we could work that land again.
Key.English: There's an old minefield just outside town, and a few mines are still in the ground. No one dares farm there. If you could clear what's left, we could work that land again.
Key.Chinesesimp: 城镇外有一片旧雷区，地下还埋着几颗地雷。没人敢在那里耕种。如果你能清除剩下的地雷，我们就能重新耕种那片土地了。

Key.Original: The locals need an old anti-personnel minefield outside town cleared. The remaining mines are marked. Disarm or destroy every mine, then report back to the local.
Key.English: The locals need an old anti-personnel minefield outside town cleared. The remaining mines are marked. Disarm or destroy every mine, then report back to the local.
Key.Chinesesimp: 当地居民需要清除城镇外一片旧的杀伤人员雷区。剩余地雷已标出。拆除或摧毁每一颗地雷，然后向当地居民回报。

Key.Original: The locals need an old anti-tank minefield outside town cleared. The remaining mines are marked. Disarm or destroy every mine, then report back to the local.
Key.English: The locals need an old anti-tank minefield outside town cleared. The remaining mines are marked. Disarm or destroy every mine, then report back to the local.
Key.Chinesesimp: 当地居民需要清除城镇外一片旧的反坦克雷区。剩余地雷已标出。拆除或摧毁每一颗地雷，然后向当地居民回报。

Key.Original: Thank you. We can work that field again. It's not much, but take this.
Key.English: Thank you. We can work that field again. It's not much, but take this.
Key.Chinesesimp: 谢谢你。我们又能耕种那片地了。不多，但拿着吧。

Key.Original: I haven't seen anything. Don't ask me again.
Key.English: I haven't seen anything. Don't ask me again.
Key.German: ...(kurze Stille) Verpiss dich! (schlägt das Geld weg)
Key.Spanish: ...(breve silencio) ¡Jódete! (golpea el dinero y lo envía volando)
Key.Chinesesimp: 我什么都没看见。别再问我了。

Key.German: Ein Lieferwagen einer internationalen humanitären Organisation wurde von feindlichen Kräften beschlagnahmt. Wir müssen den Wagen zurückerobern und zur nahen Übergabestelle der internationalen humanitären Organisation bringen. (Low CP, no AP, high rep)
Key.Spanish: Un camión de suministros de una organización humanitaria internacional ha sido robado por las fuerzas enemigas. Tenemos que recuperar el camión y devolverlo al punto de entrega de la organización humanitaria internacional cercano. (Low CP, no AP, high rep)
Key.Chinesesimp: 敌军扣押了一辆属于国际援助组织的卡车。夺回该卡车并将其开往附近的援助交付点。
Key.Original: Enemy forces have seized a truck belonging to an international aid organization. Recover it and drive it to the aid delivery point nearby.
Key.English: Enemy forces have seized a truck belonging to an international aid organization. Recover it and drive it to the aid delivery point nearby.

Key.Original: Completing or failing this mission will gain or lose town rep.
Key.English: Completing or failing this mission will gain or lose town rep.
Key.Chinesesimp: 完成或失败该任务将增加或减少城镇声望。

Key.German: Hallo? Kann mich jemand hören? Hier ist IDAP. Vor einer Stunde wurde einer unserer Lieferwagen mit humanitärer Hilfe von OPFOR beschlagnahmt... Wir bitten Sie um Hilfe bei der Rückeroberung des Wagens. Seine ungefähre Richtung und der Übergabepunkt wurden auf dem GPS aktualisiert.
Key.Spanish: ¿Hola? ¿Alguien me oye? Soy IDAP. Hace una hora, uno de nuestros camiones de suministros cargado de ayuda humanitaria fue robado por OPFOR... Les pedimos ayuda para recuperar el camión. Su dirección aproximada y el punto de entrega han sido actualizados en el GPS.
Key.Chinesesimp: 喂？有人能听到吗？这里是 IDAP。一小时前，武装人员劫走了我们一辆满载人道主义援助物资的卡车。我们需要帮助找回它。它的最后已知位置和我们的交付点已标注在你的地图上。
Key.Original: Hello? Can anyone hear me? This is IDAP. An hour ago armed men seized one of our trucks loaded with humanitarian aid. We need help getting it back. Its last known position and our delivery point are marked on your map.
Key.English: Hello? Can anyone hear me? This is IDAP. An hour ago armed men seized one of our trucks loaded with humanitarian aid. We need help getting it back. Its last known position and our delivery point are marked on your map.

Key.German: Hier ist BLUFOR-Kommando. Wir haben Ihre Anfrage erhalten. Einheiten sind zum markierten Ort unterwegs ———— "Overlord 1-1" an Einsatzteam, habt ihr die Übertragung alle verstanden?
Key.Spanish: Aquí mando BLUFOR. Hemos recibido su solicitud. Unidades en camino a la ubicación marcada ———— "Overlord 1-1" llamando al Equipo de Acción, ¿escuchasteis esa transmisión?
Key.Chinesesimp: IDAP，这里是 Overlord。收听清楚。Alpha 1-1，前往标记位置，夺回卡车。
Key.Original: IDAP, this is Overlord. Solid copy. Alpha 1-1, move to the marked position and recover the truck.
Key.English: IDAP, this is Overlord. Solid copy. Alpha 1-1, move to the marked position and recover the truck.

Key.German: Einsatzteam verstanden, wir beginnen die Operation sobald der Plan festgelegt ist, Ende.
Key.Spanish: Equipo de Acción recibe, comenzaremos la operación una vez planificado, fuera.
Key.Chinesesimp: 收到，Overlord。正在前往夺回。通话结束。
Key.Original: Roger, Overlord. Moving to recover. Out.
Key.English: Roger, Overlord. Moving to recover. Out.

Key.German: Vielen Dank! Zivilisten im Kriegsgebiet schätzen, was Sie getan haben!
Key.Spanish: Muchas gracias! Civiles en la zona de guerra agradecen lo que han hecho!
Key.Chinesesimp: 谢谢你。%1 的居民不会忘记你所做的一切。
Key.Original: Thank you. The people of %1 won't forget what you've done.
Key.English: Thank you. The people of %1 won't forget what you've done.

Key.Original: To Alpha 1-1, the aid's back with IDAP, good work. Tasking complete. Overlord out.
Key.English: To Alpha 1-1, the aid's back with IDAP, good work. Tasking complete. Overlord out.
Key.Chinesesimp: 致 Alpha 1-1，援助物资已送还 IDAP，干得好。任务完成。Overlord 通话结束。

Key.Original: To Alpha 1-1, the aid truck is destroyed. Mission failure, disengage and RTB.
Key.English: To Alpha 1-1, the aid truck is destroyed. Mission failure, disengage and RTB.
Key.Chinesesimp: 致 Alpha 1-1，援助卡车已被摧毁。任务失败，脱离接触，返航。

Key.Original: To Alpha 1-1, IDAP's delivery crew are dead. No one is left to receive aid. Mission failure, disengage and RTB.
Key.English: To Alpha 1-1, IDAP's delivery crew are dead. No one is left to receive aid. Mission failure, disengage and RTB.
Key.Chinesesimp: 致 Alpha 1-1，IDAP 的运送人员已全部死亡，没有人能接收援助物资了。任务失败，脱离接触，返航。

Key.German: Wir haben einen Informanten, dessen Identität aufgeflogen ist. Er versteckt sich irgendwo in einem Gebäude. Geh dorthin und beschütze ihn, bevor der Feind ihn einholt und verhaftet — ja, wir können ihn noch nicht aus dem Gebiet evakuieren, weil wir ihn brauchen, um weiterhin vor Ort Informationen für uns zu sammeln. (Slightly low CP, no AP, high Rep)
Key.Spanish: Tenemos un informante cuya identidad ha sido expuesta. Se está ocultando dentro de un edificio en algún lugar. Ve allí y protégelo antes de que el enemigo lo alcance y lo arresta — sí, aún no podemos sacarlo de la zona, porque necesitamos que siga recopilando información para nosotros localmente. (Slightly low CP, no AP, high Rep)
Key.Chinesesimp: 一名高价值线人身份暴露，正躲藏在本区域的一栋建筑内。抵达他所在位置，利用补给箱加固阵地，击退敌方进攻直至其溃败。
Key.Original: A high value informant has been made and is holed up in a building in this area. Reach him, use the supply crate to fortify his position, and repel enemy attacks until they break.
Key.English: A high value informant has been made and is holed up in a building in this area. Reach him, use the supply crate to fortify his position, and repel enemy attacks until they break.

Key.Original:
Keep a squad member within 300m of the informant or the mission will fail.
Completing or failing this mission will gain or lose town rep.
Key.English:
Keep a squad member within 300m of the informant or the mission will fail.
Completing or failing this mission will gain or lose town rep.
Key.Chinesesimp:
让至少一名小队成员保持在线人 300 米范围内，否则任务将失败。
完成或失败该任务将增加或减少城镇声望。

Key.Original: Priority directive, Alpha 1-1. An informant has been compromised and needs his position held against enemy attack. He is a high value asset, we need him alive.
Key.English: Priority directive, Alpha 1-1. An informant has been compromised and needs his position held against enemy attack. He is a high value asset, we need him alive.
Key.Chinesesimp: 优先指令，Alpha 1-1。一名线人身份暴露，需要坚守阵地以抵御敌方进攻。他是高价值资产，我们需要他活着。

Key.Original: Copy, Overlord. Moving to the informant now.
Key.English: Copy, Overlord. Moving to the informant now.
Key.Chinesesimp: 明白，Overlord。正在前往线人所在位置。

Key.Original: Fortify the informant's position. Build defenses from the supply crate. The assault begins in 15 minutes.
Key.English: Fortify the informant's position. Build defenses from the supply crate. The assault begins in 15 minutes.
Key.Chinesesimp: 加固线人所在阵地。利用补给箱建造防御工事。进攻将在 15 分钟后开始。

Key.Original: Thank god you're here. They'll be here any minute now. We should make ready while we still can.
Key.English: Thank god you're here. They'll be here any minute now. We should make ready while we still can.
Key.Chinesesimp: 谢天谢地你们来了。他们随时都会到。我们得趁还有时间赶紧准备。

Key.Original: You have %1 minute(s) before the assault.
Key.English: You have %1 minute(s) before the assault.
Key.Chinesesimp: 距离进攻开始还有 %1 分钟。

Key.Original: Be advised, we have reports of multiple contacts converging on the informant's position.
Key.English: Be advised, we have reports of multiple contacts converging on the informant's position.
Key.Chinesesimp: 注意，有报告称多股敌军正向线人所在位置逼近。

Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, hold the line. Do not let them reach him.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, hold the line. Do not let them reach him.
Key.Chinesesimp: Alpha 1-1，坚守阵地。不要让他们靠近他。

Key.Original: Hold your position for 30 minutes and stay within 300m of the informant.
Key.English: Hold your position for 30 minutes and stay within 300m of the informant.
Key.Chinesesimp: 坚守阵地 30 分钟，并保持在线人 300 米范围内。

Key.Original: No friendly forces within 300m of the informant. The mission will fail in %1s.
Key.English: No friendly forces within 300m of the informant. The mission will fail in %1s.
Key.Chinesesimp: 线人 300 米范围内没有友军。任务将在 %1 秒后失败。

Key.Original: The assault will break in %1 minute(s).
Key.English: The assault will break in %1 minute(s).
Key.Chinesesimp: 进攻将在 %1 分钟后瓦解。

Key.Original: The assault will end in %1 second(s).
Key.English: The assault will end in %1 second(s).
Key.Chinesesimp: 进攻将在 %1 秒后结束。

Key.Original: Good work Alpha 1-1. The assault is breaking off. Ensure the area is clear and RTB. Overlord out.
Key.English: Good work Alpha 1-1. The assault is breaking off. Ensure the area is clear and RTB. Overlord out.
Key.Chinesesimp: 干得好，Alpha 1-1。敌方进攻已瓦解。确保该区域已清空，然后返航。Overlord 通话结束。

Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, the informant is dead. Nothing more we can do. Disengage and RTB.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, the informant is dead. Nothing more we can do. Disengage and RTB.
Key.Chinesesimp: Alpha 1-1，线人已死亡。我们无能为力了。脱离接触，返航。

Key.Original: Are you sure you want to skip the prep phase? The assault will begin immediately.
Key.English: Are you sure you want to skip the prep phase? The assault will begin immediately.
Key.Chinesesimp: 确定要跳过准备阶段吗？进攻将立即开始。
找到 %1 件物品。检查你的物品栏。

Key.Original: An enemy informant is operating among the civilians in this town. Find and kill him before he slips out of the area by car. Be advised that in the event locals are hostile, they will not offer you any information, and it is advisable you wait for his departure.
Key.English: An enemy informant is operating among the civilians in this town. Find and kill him before he slips out of the area by car. Be advised that in the event locals are hostile, they will not offer you any information, and it is advisable you wait for his departure.
Key.Chinesesimp: 一名敌方线人正混迹于本城镇的平民之中活动。在他乘车逃离该区域前找到并击毙他。注意，若当地居民抱有敌意，将不会向你提供任何信息，此时建议等待他离开。

Key.Original: Killing the informant too close to town (300m) will cause reputational damage with the locals.
Key.English: Killing the informant too close to town (300m) will cause reputational damage with the locals.
Key.Chinesesimp: 在距离城镇过近（300 米内）击毙线人，将损害与当地居民的声望关系。

Key.Original: An enemy informant is hiding among the civilians. Kill him before he escapes to %1. He will leave at %2, or sooner if shots are fired, in a %3.
Key.English: An enemy informant is hiding among the civilians. Kill him before he escapes to %1. He will leave at %2, or sooner if shots are fired, in a %3.
Key.Chinesesimp: 一名敌方线人藏匿于平民之中。在他逃往 %1 前将其击毙。他将于 %2 离开，若响起枪声则会提前，乘坐一辆 %3。

Key.Original: Copy. Moving to intercept before he displaces.
Key.English: Copy. Moving to intercept before he displaces.
Key.Chinesesimp: 明白。正在前往拦截，赶在他转移之前。

Key.Original: All units, an enemy informant is operating out of %1. Locate and eliminate him before he reaches %2 by vehicle. He is set to leave at %3 in a %4, and will displace early if a firefight breaks out.
Key.English: All units, an enemy informant is operating out of %1. Locate and eliminate him before he reaches %2 by vehicle. He is set to leave at %3 in a %4, and will displace early if a firefight breaks out.
Key.Chinesesimp: 全体单位，一名敌方线人正在 %1 活动。在他乘坐载具抵达 %2 前将其定位并消灭。他计划于 %3 乘坐一辆 %4 离开，若发生交火将提前转移。

Key.Original: To Alpha 1-1, the informant has been disposed of. Good work.
Key.English: To Alpha 1-1, the informant has been disposed of. Good work.
Key.Chinesesimp: 致 Alpha 1-1，线人已被除掉。干得好。

Key.Original: The informant has reached %1. Mission failed.
Key.English: The informant has reached %1. Mission failed.

Key.Original: The high-value target is fleeing to %1 by convoy, riding in a %2. Intel puts him in one of three columns running separate routes. Eliminate him before his column reaches %1.
Key.English: The high-value target is fleeing to %1 by convoy, riding in a %2. Intel puts him in one of three columns running separate routes. Eliminate him before his column reaches %1.
Key.Chinesesimp: 高价值目标正乘车队逃往 %1，乘坐一辆 %2。情报显示他位于分三条独立路线行进的其中一支纵队。在其纵队抵达 %1 前将他消灭。

Key.Original: The high-value target reached %1. Mission failed.
Key.English: The high-value target reached %1. Mission failed.
Key.Chinesesimp: 高价值目标已抵达 %1。任务失败。

Key.Original: An unscouted enemy position needs eyes on it. Move to the marked overwatch, raise your binoculars, and hold observation until Allseer confirms the intel. Its location is then marked on your map.
Key.English: An unscouted enemy position needs eyes on it. Move to the marked overwatch, raise your binoculars, and hold observation until Allseer confirms the intel. Its location is then marked on your map.
Key.Chinesesimp: 一处未经侦察的敌方阵地需要监视。前往标记的观察点，举起望远镜，持续观察直至 Allseer 确认情报。其位置随后将标注在你的地图上。

Key.Original: Reach the marked overwatch, raise your binoculars, and hold observation on the enemy position until Allseer confirms the intel. Its location is then marked on your map.
Key.English: Reach the marked overwatch, raise your binoculars, and hold observation on the enemy position until Allseer confirms the intel. Its location is then marked on your map.
Key.Chinesesimp: 抵达标记的观察点，举起望远镜，持续观察该敌方阵地直至 Allseer 确认情报。其位置随后将标注在你的地图上。

Key.Original: Copy Overlord. Moving to the overwatch.
Key.English: Copy Overlord. Moving to the overwatch.

Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, we have an unscouted enemy position near %1. Move to the marked overwatch and observe it through binoculars until Allseer confirms the intel.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, we have an unscouted enemy position near %1. Move to the marked overwatch and observe it through binoculars until Allseer confirms the intel.
Key.Chinesesimp: Alpha 1-1，%1 附近有一处未经侦察的敌方阵地。前往标记的观察点，用望远镜观察，直至 Allseer 确认情报。

Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, Allseer has received your intel and confirmed the enemy position. It's now marked on your map.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, Allseer has received your intel and confirmed the enemy position. It's now marked on your map.
Key.Chinesesimp: Alpha 1-1，Allseer 已收到你的情报并确认了敌方阵地位置。现已标注在你的地图上。

Key.Original: We've got intel on more enemy positions in the area. They're now marked on your map too.
Key.English: We've got intel on more enemy positions in the area. They're now marked on your map too.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我们又获得了本区域更多敌方阵地的情报。它们现也已标注在你的地图上。

Key.Original: The informant is about %1 m %2 of you.
Key.English: The informant is about %1 m %2 of you.
Key.Chinesesimp: 线人在你 %2 方向约 %1 米处。

Key.Original: The informant is nearby, %1 of you.
Key.English: The informant is nearby, %1 of you.
Key.Chinesesimp: 线人就在附近，位于你的 %1 方向。

Key.Original: Him? I think I just saw him leave town heading %1.
Key.English: Him? I think I just saw him leave town heading %1.
Key.Chinesesimp: 他？我好像刚看到他朝 %1 方向离开城镇了。

Key.Original: Him? I thought I saw him over there...
Key.English: Him? I thought I saw him over there...
Key.Chinesesimp: 他？我好像看到他在那边……

Key.Original: An OPFOR informant safehouse is hidden amongst the local populace here. Work with the locals for a lead, find the right one, breach it, and seize the intel cache inside.
Key.English: An OPFOR informant safehouse is hidden amongst the local populace here. Work with the locals for a lead, find the right one, breach it, and seize the intel cache inside.
Key.Chinesesimp: 一处 OPFOR 线人安全屋隐藏在此地居民之中。向当地居民打探线索，找出正确的那栋房屋，破门而入，夺取其中的情报箱。

Key.Original: Shoot a door to breach a locked house. Breaching the wrong house will incur a rep penalty.
Key.English: Shoot a door to breach a locked house. Breaching the wrong house will incur a rep penalty.
Key.Chinesesimp: 向门开枪即可破门进入上锁的房屋。破入错误的房屋将受到声望惩罚。

Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, Allseer has located an enemy safehouse full of intel amongst the population of %1. Find it, breach it, and retrieve the cache.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, Allseer has located an enemy safehouse full of intel amongst the population of %1. Find it, breach it, and retrieve the cache.
Key.Chinesesimp: Alpha 1-1，Allseer 已在 %1 的居民之中定位到一处藏有大量情报的敌方安全屋。找到它，破门而入，取出情报箱。

Key.Original: Roger that Overlord. We'll be en route to the location now.
Key.English: Roger that Overlord. We'll be en route to the location now.
Key.Chinesesimp: 收到，Overlord。我们这就前往该位置。

Key.Original: Oh yeah. There's been some suspicious people in town recently.
Key.English: Oh yeah. There's been some suspicious people in town recently.
Key.Chinesesimp: 哦对了。最近镇上出现了一些可疑的人。

Key.Original: One of the houses has been ruled out on your map.

Key.German: ==AUFKLÄRUNGSDATEN GEFUNDEN==\n\nPosition aller Zonen wurden auf der Karte aufgedeckt.
Key.Spanish: ==Inteligencia recuperada==\n Todas las zonas han sido reveladas en el mapa.
Key.Chinesesimp: ==已获取情报==\n\n所有区域已在地图上标示。
Key.Original: ==INTEL RECOVERED==\n\nAll Zones have been revealed on the map.
Key.English: ==INTEL RECOVERED==\n\nAll Zones have been revealed on the map.

Key.German:
Der Feind kontrolliert einige strategisch wichtige Zonen. Wir müssen diese Gebiete zurückerobern! Erobere für einen erfolgreichen Missionsabschluss alle vom Feind besetzten Zonen.
Du kannst BLUFOR helfen die Zonen zurückzuerobern und/oder sekundäre Missionen abschließen um die verfügbaren BLUFOR Ressourcen zu erhöhen. Während die Kampagne fortschreitet wird der Krieg eskalieren und die Armeen besseres Equipment nutzen und stärker werden.
Um eine Zone zu erobern muss unsere Präsenz der des Feindes überlegen sein.

Es liegt in deiner Hand, wie du die Mission spielen möchtest.
Viel Glück Soldat!
Key.Spanish:
El enemigo controla zonas críticas en el área ¡debemos retomarlas! Capture todas las zonas bajo control enemigo y la misión será un éxito.
Puede ayudar a BLUFOR a tomar las zonas y/o realizar misiones secundarias para incrementar los recursos de BLUFOR. Con el progreso de la campaña la guerra escalará y los ejércitos serán más fuertes
Para capturar una zona, necesitará una mayor presencia en la zona que el enemigo.

Depende de usted como quiera juagr esto.
¡Buena suerte, soldado!
Key.Chinesesimp:
敌军控制着该地区的一些关键区域，我们需要将其夺回。夺取所有被敌军控制的区域，任务即告成功。
你可以协助 BLUFOR 夺取区域，和/或完成支线任务以增加 BLUFOR 的资源。随着战役推进，战事将升级，双方军队将愈发强大，并开始动用更大型的装备。
要夺取一个区域，你在该区域内的兵力必须强于敌军。

具体如何进行，由你决定。
祝你好运，士兵！
Key.Original:
The enemy controls some critical zones in the area, and we need to take them back. Capture every zone under enemy control and the mission will succeed.
You can help BLUFOR take the zones and/or accomplish side missions to increase BLUFOR resources. As the campaign progresses, the war will escalate and the armies will get stronger and start to use bigger assets.
To capture a zone, you need to have a stronger presence in the zone than the enemy.

It's up to you how you want to play this.
Good luck, soldier!

Key.German: Stellen Sie sicher, dass wertvolle stuff das Missionsgebiet innerhalb von 6 Minuten evakuieren.
Key.Spanish: Asegúrate de que los stuff valiosos abandonen el área de misión en 6 minutos.
Key.Chinesesimp: 搜刮一切有用的物资。该区域将在五分钟后清场
Key.Original: Strip anything useful. The area will clear in five minutes
Key.English: Strip anything useful. The area will clear in five minutes

Key.German: Noch eine Minute bis zur Aufräumaktion.
Key.Spanish: Queda un minuto para la limpieza de la misión.
Key.Chinesesimp: 还剩一分钟。此后目标区域将被清场
Key.Original: One minute. The objective area is cleared after that
Key.English: One minute. The objective area is cleared after that

Key.German: Eine verbündete Angriffstruppe wurde überfallen! Sie verbirgt sich in einem Gebäude in diesem Gebiet, mit feindlichen Truppen ringsherum. Hilf ihnen, sich durchzubrechen! (Very high CP, low AP)
Key.Spanish: Un escuadrón de asalto aliado ha sido emboscado! Se oculta en un edificio de esta zona, con fuerzas enemigas a su alrededor. Ayúdalos a romper el cerco! (Very high CP, low AP)
Key.Chinesesimp: 一支突击分队在本区域遭到伏击，被围困在一栋建筑内，四周都是敌军。突破包围，将他们救出。
Key.Original: An assault element was ambushed in this area and is pinned inside a building, surrounded by hostiles. Break the cordon and bring them out.
Key.English: An assault element was ambushed in this area and is pinned inside a building, surrounded by hostiles. Break the cordon and bring them out.

Key.German: Wir haben derzeit akute Versorgungsmängel, und unser Satellit hat in diesem Gebiet die grobe Position eines feindlichen Versorgungslasters grob ermittelt. Im Laster befindet sich eine große Menge an Versorgungsgütern und ein Waffenschrank. Bring es zurück zur Basis, bevor der Feind unsere Absichten erkennt und es vernichtet. Du hast 20 Minuten Zeit. (High CP, avg AP)
Key.Spanish: Actualmente tenemos escasez de suministros, y nuestro satélite ha localizado aproximadamente la posición general de un camión de suministros enemigo en esta zona. En el camión hay una gran cantidad de suministros y un arsenal. Tráelo de vuelta a la base antes de que el enemigo descubra nuestra intención y lo destruya. Tienes 20 minutos. (High CP, avg AP)
Key.Chinesesimp: 我们的补给已经不多了。Allseer 在本区域发现一辆敌方补给卡车，满载物资和一批军械。趁敌人还没察觉我们的意图、将其销毁之前，夺取该卡车并开回基地。
Key.Original: We're low on supplies. Allseer has spotted an enemy supply truck in this area, loaded with stores and an arsenal cache. Take it and drive it back to base before the enemy destroys it once they work out what we're doing.
Key.English: We're low on supplies. Allseer has spotted an enemy supply truck in this area, loaded with stores and an arsenal cache. Take it and drive it back to base before the enemy destroys it once they work out what we're doing.

Key.German: Der Nachrichtendienst hat gerade ermittelt, dass eine feindliche vorläufige Kommandotruppe sich hier vorübergehend versammelt hat – eliminiere den Offizier in der Truppe! Nach der Eliminierung des Offiziers braucht der Nachrichtendienst noch ein paar Minuten zusätzlich, um die Zielerfüllung zu bestätigen.(Diese Mission ist extrem zeitsensitiv; sie schlägt fehl, falls sie innerhalb von 8 Minuten nicht abgeschlossen wird.) (High CP, high AP)
Key.Spanish: El servicio de inteligencia acaba de detectar que un equipo de comando temporal enemigo se ha reunido aquí temporalmente — elimína al oficial del equipo! Después de que el oficial sea eliminado, el servicio de inteligencia necesitará unos minutos adicionales para confirmar la consecución del objetivo.(Esta misión es extremadamente sensible al tiempo; fracasará si no se completa dentro de 8 minutos.) (High CP, high AP)
Key.Chinesesimp: 一名高价值目标正在武装护送下乘车队逃往一处 OPFOR 控制区域。查明他所在的载具，在他抵达该区域前将其消灭。
Key.Original: A high-value target is fleeing to an OPFOR-held zone by convoy under armed escort. Identify his vehicle and eliminate him before he reaches the zone.
Key.English: A high-value target is fleeing to an OPFOR-held zone by convoy under armed escort. Identify his vehicle and eliminate him before he reaches the zone.

Key.German: Ein freundlicher Signalturm in diesem Gebiet wurde von feindlichen Truppen eingenommen. Feindliche Truppen sind in der Nähe stationiert und entschlüsseln kritische Informationen. Sprenge den Turm, bevor die Feinde das Entschlüsseln abschließen! (Nur noch 15 Minuten, bis kritische Informationen an die Feinde gelangen!) (Slightly low CP, avg AP)
Key.Spanish: Una torre de señales aliada en esta zona ha sido tomada por fuerzas enemigas. Las tropas enemigas están acantonadas cerca y descifrando información crítica. Destruye la torre con explosivos antes de que terminen el descifrado! (¡Quedan solo 15 minutos para que la información crítica se filtre!) (Slightly low CP, avg AP)
Key.Chinesesimp: 标记位置的一座 OPFOR 无线电塔正在本区域扩散敌方影响力。携带爆破装备，将其炸毁。
Key.Original: An OPFOR radio tower at the marked position is spreading enemy influence across the sector. Bring demolitions and drop the tower.
Key.English: An OPFOR radio tower at the marked position is spreading enemy influence across the sector. Bring demolitions and drop the tower.

Key.German: Unsere kritischen Informationen werden gerade entschlüsselt! Du und deine Truppe müsst euch beeilen!
Key.Spanish: Nuestra información crítica está siendo descifrada! Tú y tu escuadrón debéis apresuraros!
Key.Chinesesimp: 他们即将破解完情报。还剩两分钟。
Key.Original: They're nearly through the intel. Two minutes left.
Key.English: They're nearly through the intel. Two minutes left.

Key.German: Eines unserer Flugzeuge wurde in der Nähe dieses Ortes abgeschossen. Satellitenmeldungen zeigen, dass der Pilot schwere Verletzungen erlitten hat und stark blutet – beeil dich zum Absturzort und bring ihn sicher zurück zur Basis. (Nur noch 10 Minuten, bis der Pilot an Blutverlust stirbt!) (Avg CP, very high AP)
Key.Spanish: Uno de nuestros aviones fue derribado cerca de esta posición. Los informes satelitales indican que el piloto sufre graves heridas y hemorragia intensa – apúrate al lugar del accidente aéreo y tráelo seguro de vuelta a la base. (¡Quedan solo 10 minutos hasta que el piloto muera por hemorragia!) (Avg CP, very high AP)
Key.Chinesesimp: 我方一架飞机在本位置附近坠毁。飞行员还活着。前往坠机地点，把他带回基地。
Key.Original: One of our aircraft went down near this position. The pilot's alive. Get to the crash site and carry him back to base.
Key.English: One of our aircraft went down near this position. The pilot's alive. Get to the crash site and carry him back to base.

Key.Original: The pilot will begin bleeding out once players are within range. He will have 10 minutes.
Key.English: The pilot will begin bleeding out once players are within range. He will have 10 minutes.
Key.Chinesesimp: 玩家进入范围后，飞行员将开始流血。他还能撑 10 分钟。

Key.German: Du kannst keinen Piloten absetzen, den du nicht trägst
Key.Spanish: No puedes poner a un piloto que no estás cargando

Key.German: Pilot befindet sich bereits im Fahrzeug
Key.Spanish: El piloto ya está dentro del vehículo
Key.Original: The pilot is already in the vehicle.
Key.English: The pilot is already in the vehicle.

Key.German: Kann Pilot nicht in Fahrzeug setzen, bitte versuche es erneut
Key.Spanish: No se puede poner al piloto en el vehículo, inténtalo de nuevo
Key.Chinesesimp: 无法将飞行员装入载具。再试一次。
Key.Original: Couldn't load the pilot into the vehicle. Try again.
Key.English: Couldn't load the pilot into the vehicle. Try again.

Key.German: Pilot ist nicht in diesem Fahrzeug
Key.Spanish: El piloto no está en este vehículo
Key.Original: The pilot isn't in this vehicle.
Key.English: The pilot isn't in this vehicle.

Key.Chinesesimp: 你已经在携带飞行员了。

Key.German: Du trägst einen Piloten, Pilot wurde automatisch abgesetzt
Key.Spanish: Estás cargando un piloto, el piloto ha sido soltado automáticamente
Key.Chinesesimp: 你之前正携带着飞行员，因此已将他放在了这里。
Key.Original: You were already carrying the pilot, so he's been set down here.
Key.English: You were already carrying the pilot, so he's been set down here.

Key.Original: No vehicle close enough to load the pilot into.
Key.English: No vehicle close enough to load the pilot into.
Key.Chinesesimp: 附近没有可供装载飞行员的载具。

Key.German: Der Nachrichtendienst hat zwei feindliche Scharfschützen in diesem Bereich gesichtet – eliminiere sie! (Nach der Eliminierung der Scharfschützen braucht der Nachrichtendienst noch ein paar Minuten zusätzlich, um die Mission abschließend zu bestätigen.) (Slightly high CP, Slightly high AP)
Key.Spanish: El servicio de inteligencia ha detectado a dos francotiradores enemigos en esta zona — elimínalos! (Después de que los francotiradores sean eliminados, el servicio de inteligencia necesitará unos minutos adicionales para confirmar la finalización de la misión.) (Slightly high CP, Slightly high AP)
Key.Chinesesimp: Allseer 追踪到一支敌方狙击手小组正在本区域活动。将其全部消灭。
Key.Original: Allseer has tracked an enemy sniper element working this area. Kill them all.
Key.English: Allseer has tracked an enemy sniper element working this area. Kill them all.

Key.German: Der Nachrichtendienst hat angegeben, dass die Feinde hier ein Ingenieurfahrzeug aufgestellt haben. Ergreife es und bring es zurück zur Basis. Es kann zu einer mobilen Fabrik umgewandelt werden. (Low CP, low AP)
Key.Spanish: El servicio de inteligencia ha indicado que el enemigo ha desplegado un vehículo de ingeniería aquí. Aprópialo y tráelo de vuelta a la base. Puede ser convertido en una fábrica móvil. (Low CP, low AP)
Key.Chinesesimp: Allseer 在此坐标标记了一辆敌方工程载具。将其完好夺取并送回基地，我方工兵可将其改造为机动工厂。
Key.Original: Allseer has marked an enemy engineering vehicle at this grid. Seize it intact and return it to base; our engineers can convert it into a mobile factory.
Key.English: Allseer has marked an enemy engineering vehicle at this grid. Seize it intact and return it to base; our engineers can convert it into a mobile factory.

Key.Original: An enemy vehicle patrol is operating in this area. Destroy the whole column.
Key.English: An enemy vehicle patrol is operating in this area. Destroy the whole column.
Key.Chinesesimp: 一支敌方载具巡逻队正在本区域活动。摧毁整支纵队。

Key.German: Die Späher melden, dass die Feinde hier laptopartige elektronische Kampfgeräte aufgestellt haben, in denen möglicherweise Informationen über die Standorte feindlicher Truppenstellungen enthalten sind. Suchen Sie das Gerät auf, laden Sie alle nützlichen Informationen herunter und zerstören Sie es, falls es keine gibt. (Very low CP, high AP)
Key.Spanish: Los exploradores informan de que el enemigo ha desplegado un dispositivo de guerra electrónica de estilo portátil aquí, que puede contener información sobre las posiciones de despliegue enemigo. Localiza el dispositivo, descarga toda la información útil y destrúyelo si no hay ninguna. (Very low CP, high AP)
Key.Chinesesimp: 侦察兵报告，标记区域内的一栋建筑中藏有一台敌方野战笔记本电脑。这是可能记录着他们部署位置的电子战设备。找到该笔记本电脑并将其破坏。
Key.Original: Scouts report an enemy field laptop in the marked area, hidden in one of the flagged buildings. It's electronic warfare gear that may hold their deployment positions. Find the laptop and sabotage it.
Key.English: Scouts report an enemy field laptop in the marked area, hidden in one of the flagged buildings. It's electronic warfare gear that may hold their deployment positions. Find the laptop and sabotage it.

Key.German: Der kleine feindliche Waffenschatz befindet sich hier. Sprenge ihn! (Slightly high CP, low AP)
Key.Spanish: El pequeño depósito de armas enemigo está aquí. Destrúyelo con explosivos! (Slightly high CP, low AP)
Key.Chinesesimp: 敌军在本区域设有一处小型弹药藏匿点。携带炸药，将其夷平。
Key.Original: The enemy runs a small ammunition cache out of this area. Bring explosives and level it.
Key.English: The enemy runs a small ammunition cache out of this area. Bring explosives and level it.

Key.German: Der Feind hat in diesem Gebiet ein Luftverteidigungsradar aufgestellt, und es stört unsere Luftoperationen. Du musst es zerstören. (Nach der Zerstörung des Radars braucht der Nachrichtendienst noch ein paar Minuten, um zu bestätigen, dass das Radar neutralisiert wurde.) (Avg CP, slightly low AP)
Key.Spanish: El enemigo ha desplegado un radar de defensa aérea en esta área, y está interrumpiendo nuestras operaciones aéreas. Debes destruirlo. (Después de que el radar sea destruido, el servicio de inteligencia necesitará unos minutos para confirmar que el radar ha sido neutralizado.) (Avg CP, slightly low AP)
Key.Chinesesimp: 本区域的一部敌方防空雷达正把我方飞机拒之于天空之外。将其摧毁。
Key.Original: An enemy AA radar in this area is shutting our aircraft out of the sky. Destroy it.
Key.English: An enemy AA radar in this area is shutting our aircraft out of the sky. Destroy it.

Key.German: Nicht genung sichere Positionen für die Generierung der Mission gefunden. Versuche es erneut.
Key.Spanish: No hay suficientes posiciones seguras para la generación de misiones. Intente de nuevo.
Key.Chinesesimp: 任务生成失败。重新打开支线任务选择器。
Key.Original: Mission generation failed. Try the side mission picker again.
Key.English: Mission generation failed. Try the side mission picker again.

Key.Chinesesimp: 支线任务派发将于 %1 后恢复。在总部休整可将时间快进 3 小时。
Key.Original: Side mission tasking unavailable until %1. Rest at HQ to fast-forward time by 3 hours.
Key.English: Side mission tasking unavailable until %1. Rest at HQ to fast-forward time by 3 hours.

Key.Original: Mission generation failed. Try the side mission picker again.
Key.English: Mission generation failed. Try the side mission picker again.
Key.Chinesesimp: 任务生成失败。重新打开支线任务选择器。

Key.Spanish: == MISIÓN SECUNDARIA FALLIDA==\n\n ¡El piloto ha muerto!

Key.Original: The pilot will bleed out in %1 minute(s). Get him back to HQ.
Key.English: The pilot will bleed out in %1 minute(s). Get him back to HQ.
Key.Chinesesimp: 飞行员将在 %1 分钟后流血死亡。把他带回总部。

Key.German: Scheiße... Mein Bein ist verletzt. Hast du ein Sanitätspaket?
Key.Spanish: Joder... Me he lastimado la pierna. ¿Tienes un botiquín?
Key.Chinesesimp: 我的腿伤得很重，走不了路。你得背着我走。
Key.Original: My leg's in bad shape, I can't walk. You'll have to carry me.
Key.English: My leg's in bad shape, I can't walk. You'll have to carry me.

Key.German: Endlich zurück! Vielen Dank an euch!
Key.Chinesesimp: 我们做到了。谢谢你带我一程。
Key.Original: We made it. Thanks for the lift.
Key.English: We made it. Thanks for the lift.

Key.German: „Overlord“ an Einsatztrupp, gut gemacht. Ich wette, dieser Pilot vergisst euch sein ganzes Leben lang nicht.
Key.Spanish: "Overlord" al escuadrón de acción, bien hecho. Apuesto a que ese piloto nunca os olvida en toda su vida.
Key.Chinesesimp: 成功撤离，干得好，Alpha 1-1。休整并待命，等候进一步任务。
Key.Original: Good work with the successful exfil Alpha 1-1. Rest and standby for further tasking.
Key.English: Good work with the successful exfil Alpha 1-1. Rest and standby for further tasking.

Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, the pilot is dead. Nothing more we can do. Disengage and RTB.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, the pilot is dead. Nothing more we can do. Disengage and RTB.
Key.Chinesesimp: Alpha 1-1，飞行员已死亡。我们无能为力了。脱离接触，返航。

Key.Original: To Alpha 1-1, that patrol's wiped out. Every vehicle confirmed destroyed. Good work.
Key.English: To Alpha 1-1, that patrol's wiped out. Every vehicle confirmed destroyed. Good work.
Key.Chinesesimp: 致 Alpha 1-1，该巡逻队已被全歼。所有载具确认摧毁。干得好。

Key.Original: Patrol scales with enemy strength. Motorised: 15/20, Mechanised: 25/25, Armor: 35/30 (CP/AP)
Key.English: Patrol scales with enemy strength. Motorised: 15/20, Mechanised: 25/25, Armor: 35/30 (CP/AP)
Key.Chinesesimp: 巡逻队规模随敌方实力变化。摩托化：15/20，机械化：25/25，装甲：35/30 （CP/AP）

Key.Original: Our air support caught an enemy tank in the open and disabled it, but its hull is intact and a recovery convoy is already inbound to get it running. Destroy the tank, or kill the crew before they recover it and drive it back to their lines. Be advised the convoy moves in under armed escort.
Key.English: Our air support caught an enemy tank in the open and disabled it, but its hull is intact and a recovery convoy is already inbound to get it running. Destroy the tank, or kill the crew before they recover it and drive it back to their lines. Be advised the convoy moves in under armed escort.
Key.Chinesesimp: 我方空中支援在空旷地带发现并瘫痪了一辆敌方坦克，但其车体完好，一支抢修车队已在前往途中，准备让它重新运转。摧毁该坦克，或在敌方修复并将其开回己方战线前消灭车组人员。注意，该车队有武装护送。

Key.Original: Roger Overlord. Moving to hit it before they recover it.
Key.English: Roger Overlord. Moving to hit it before they recover it.
Key.Chinesesimp: 收到，Overlord。正在赶往，趁敌方修复前将其摧毁。

Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, our close air support disabled an enemy tank near %1 and its crew is moving up to recover it. Destroy the tank or eliminate the crew before it's recovered.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, our close air support disabled an enemy tank near %1 and its crew is moving up to recover it. Destroy the tank or eliminate the crew before it's recovered.
Key.Chinesesimp: Alpha 1-1，我方近距空中支援瘫痪了 %1 附近的一辆敌方坦克，其车组人员正赶来抢修。在其被修复前摧毁坦克或消灭车组人员。

Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, eyes on the recovery convoy, inbound along the marked approach with an armed escort.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, eyes on the recovery convoy, inbound along the marked approach with an armed escort.
Key.Chinesesimp: Alpha 1-1，发现抢修车队，正沿标记路线即将抵达，有武装护送。

Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, the enemy tank is operational and withdrawing toward their lines.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, the enemy tank is operational and withdrawing toward their lines.
Key.Chinesesimp: Alpha 1-1，敌方坦克已恢复运转，正撤向己方战线。

Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, that enemy armor is confirmed out of action. Good work.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, that enemy armor is confirmed out of action. Good work.
Key.Chinesesimp: Alpha 1-1，确认该敌方装甲已被摧毁。干得好。

Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, the recovery crew is confirmed eliminated. Good work.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, the recovery crew is confirmed eliminated. Good work.
Key.Chinesesimp: Alpha 1-1，确认抢修车组已被消灭。干得好。

Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, the enemy have recovered their armor and have withdrawn.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, the enemy have recovered their armor and have withdrawn.
Key.Chinesesimp: Alpha 1-1，敌方已修复其装甲并已撤离。

Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, good work requisitioning that armor. RTB with the asset.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, good work requisitioning that armor. RTB with the asset.
Key.Chinesesimp: Alpha 1-1，成功征用该装甲，干得好。携带该资产返航。

Key.Original: Repairing the vehicle and entering it will also complete the mission. It must be repaired to 50% or more.
Key.English: Repairing the vehicle and entering it will also complete the mission. It must be repaired to 50% or more.
Key.Chinesesimp: 修复该载具并进入其中也可完成任务。必须修复至 50% 以上。

Key.German: "Overlord 1-1" an Action Squad, Radar zerstört – bestätigt. Gute Arbeit.
Key.Spanish: "Overlord 1-1" a Action Squad, radar destruido, confirmado. Muy bien hecho.
Key.Chinesesimp: Alpha 1-1，雷达确认摧毁。干得漂亮。
Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, radar confirmed destroyed. Well done.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, radar confirmed destroyed. Well done.

Key.German: Seien Sie informiert, Action Squad, hier spricht "Overlord". Der vorläufige feindliche Kommandant ist eliminierter – bestätigt. Perfekte Operation.
Key.Spanish: Tengan conocimiento, Action Squad, aquí "Overlord". Comandante temporal enemigo eliminado, confirmado. Operación perfecta.
Key.Chinesesimp: Alpha 1-1，高价值目标确认击毙。干得好。
Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, the high-value target is confirmed dead. Good work.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, the high-value target is confirmed dead. Good work.

Key.German: Ihr seid endlich da! Evakuiert sofort – Feinde sind überall um uns herum!
Key.Spanish: ¡Finalmente llegaron! ¡Evacuense rápido! Hay enemigos por todas partes a nuestro alrededor.
Key.Chinesesimp: 见到你太好了，Alpha 1-1。我们已准备就绪，随时可以行动。
Key.Original: Good to see you, Alpha 1-1. We're up and ready to move.
Key.English: Good to see you, Alpha 1-1. We're up and ready to move.

Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, good work sabotaging the enemy laptop. Out.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, good work sabotaging the enemy laptop. Out.
Key.Chinesesimp: Alpha 1-1，成功破坏敌方笔记本电脑，干得好。通话结束。

Key.Original: This decoy was rigged with a bomb, clear the area!
Key.English: This decoy was rigged with a bomb, clear the area!
Key.Chinesesimp: 这个诱饵装有炸弹，立即撤离该区域！

Key.Original: This laptop is a decoy. Keep searching.
Key.English: This laptop is a decoy. Keep searching.
Key.Chinesesimp: 这台笔记本电脑是诱饵。继续搜索。

Key.Original: Clear the area of OPFOR first.
Key.English: Clear the area of OPFOR first.
Key.Chinesesimp: 先清除该区域内的 OPFOR。

Key.German: ==DEIN BAU-FAHRZEUG IST NOCH INTAKT==\n\nEs ist nur 1 Bau-Fahrzeug gleichzeitig in der Mission erlaubt! Bitte wähle eine andere Mission.
Key.Spanish: ==SU VEHÍCULO CONSTRUCTOR SIGUE INTACTO==\n\n ¡Solo se permite un vehículo constructor a la vez en el mapa! Por favor escoja otra misión.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你一次只能拥有一辆建造载具。任务已中止。
Key.Original: You can only have one builder vehicle at a time. Mission aborted.
Key.English: You can only have one builder vehicle at a time. Mission aborted.

Key.Spanish: ==MISIÓN SECUNDARIA FALLIDA==\n\n Ventana de oportunidad de alto valor expirada!
Key.Chinesesimp: ==支线任务失败==\n\n 指挥小组在军官倒下前已经四散。
Key.Original: ==SIDE MISSION FAILED==\n\nThe command team dispersed before the officer went down.
Key.English: ==SIDE MISSION FAILED==\n\nThe command team dispersed before the officer went down.

Key.German: Signal 2-2 an alle Einheiten, gute Nachricht: Wir haben gerade den feindlichen Versorgungslaster entdeckt, Koordinaten wurden ins Informationssystem hochgeladen.
Key.Spanish: Signal 2-2 a todas las unidades, buenas noticias: Acabamos de localizar el camión de suministros enemigo, coordenadas subidas al sistema de información.
Key.Chinesesimp: Allseer 呼叫 Overlord。发现一辆敌方补给卡车位于标记坐标，看起来即将转移。建议派遣一支小队将其夺取。
Key.Original: Allseer to Overlord. Eyes on an enemy supply truck at the marked grid, looks ready to displace. Recommend you task a team to seize it.
Key.English: Allseer to Overlord. Eyes on an enemy supply truck at the marked grid, looks ready to displace. Recommend you task a team to seize it.

Key.Original: Roger Overlord. Moving to seize it now.
Key.English: Roger Overlord. Moving to seize it now.

Key.German: "Overlord 1-1" an "Signal 2-2", die Action Squad ist zum Zielbereich unterwegs. Ihr dürft abziehen.
Key.Spanish: "Overlord 1-1" a "Signal 2-2", el Action Squad se dirige al área objetivo. Tienen permiso para retirarse.
Key.Chinesesimp: 致 Alpha 1-1，优先任务：夺取补给卡车并返航。敌方一旦察觉就会将其销毁，务必从速。
Key.Original: To Alpha 1-1, priority tasking: seize the supply truck and RTB. They'll scuttle it the moment they catch on, so expedite.
Key.English: To Alpha 1-1, priority tasking: seize the supply truck and RTB. They'll scuttle it the moment they catch on, so expedite.

Key.German: "Overlord" an Action Squad, Mission fehlgeschlagen, verlasse den Zielbereich sofort!
Key.Spanish: "Overlord" al Action Squad, misión fallida, retirese del área objetivo lo antes posible!
Key.Chinesesimp: 致 Alpha 1-1，卡车已报废，任务取消。脱离接触，返航。
Key.Original: To Alpha 1-1, truck's a write-off, tasking scrubbed. Disengage and RTB.
Key.English: To Alpha 1-1, truck's a write-off, tasking scrubbed. Disengage and RTB.

Key.Original: To Alpha 1-1, truck's secure at base, good work. Enemy stores are being logged into your arsenal now.
Key.English: To Alpha 1-1, truck's secure at base, good work. Enemy stores are being logged into your arsenal now.
Key.Chinesesimp: 致 Alpha 1-1，卡车已安全送抵基地，干得好。敌方物资正被录入你的军械库。

Key.Original: This is Allseer. Be advised, enemy engineering vehicle parked at the marked grid. No sign they're moving it yet.
Key.English: This is Allseer. Be advised, enemy engineering vehicle parked at the marked grid. No sign they're moving it yet.
Key.Chinesesimp: 这里是 Allseer。注意，一辆敌方工程载具停放在标记坐标。目前没有迹象表明其即将转移。

Key.Original: Copy. Moving to secure it now.
Key.English: Copy. Moving to secure it now.

Key.Original: To Alpha 1-1, secure that engineering vehicle and bring it back to the motor pool for repurposing.
Key.English: To Alpha 1-1, secure that engineering vehicle and bring it back to the motor pool for repurposing.
Key.Chinesesimp: 致 Alpha 1-1，夺取该工程载具并将其带回车库以便改装再利用。

Key.Original: Well done Alpha 1-1, vehicle recovered. You are free to reuse it as a mobile factory.
Key.English: Well done Alpha 1-1, vehicle recovered. You are free to reuse it as a mobile factory.
Key.Chinesesimp: 干得漂亮，Alpha 1-1，载具已夺回。你可以将其作为机动工厂使用。

Key.Original: To Alpha 1-1, the vehicle's a total loss, abort tasking.
Key.English: To Alpha 1-1, the vehicle's a total loss, abort tasking.
Key.Chinesesimp: 致 Alpha 1-1，该载具已彻底损毁，任务中止。

Key.German: Dies ist „Oberherr 1-1“. Aufklärer haben gerade das feindliche Arsenal lokalisiert. Ihr wisst, was zu tun ist.
Key.Spanish: Este es "Imperador 1-1". Los exploradores han localizado recientemente el arsenal enemigo. Saben lo que tienen que hacer.
Key.Chinesesimp: 侦察兵已锁定敌方弹药藏匿点位置。携带炸药，将其夷平。
Key.Original: Scouts have pinpointed the enemy ammo cache. Bring explosives and level it.
Key.English: Scouts have pinpointed the enemy ammo cache. Bring explosives and level it.

Key.German: Action Squad, verstanden. Zum Ziel unterwegs.
Key.Spanish: Action Squad, recibido. Vamos al objetivo.

Key.Original: To Alpha 1-1, Allseer confirms the ammunition cache is destroyed. Good work. Overlord out.
Key.English: To Alpha 1-1, Allseer confirms the ammunition cache is destroyed. Good work. Overlord out.
Key.Chinesesimp: 致 Alpha 1-1，Allseer 确认弹药藏匿点已摧毁。干得好。Overlord 通话结束。

Key.Original: Roger. Moving to locate his vehicle.
Key.English: Roger. Moving to locate his vehicle.
Key.Chinesesimp: 收到。正在前往定位他的载具。

Key.German: "Overlord 1-1" an alle Einheiten, Notfall! Wir haben gerade die vorläufige feindliche Kommandomannschaft gesichtet – alle Bereitschaftseinheiten sollen sich bewegen und den vorläufigen Kommandanten sofort eliminieren!
Key.Spanish: "Overlord 1-1" a todas las unidades, emergencia! Acabamos de localizar el equipo de comando temporal enemigo – todas las unidades en espera deben desplazarse y eliminar al comandante temporal de inmediato!
Key.Chinesesimp: Alpha 1-1，一名高价值目标正乘车队逃往 %1。情报显示他位于分三条独立路线行进的其中一支纵队，乘坐一辆 %2。找到该载具，在其纵队抵达该区域前将他消灭。
Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, a high-value target is fleeing to %1 by convoy. Intel puts him in one of three columns running separate routes, riding in a %2. Find that vehicle and eliminate him before his column reaches the zone.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, a high-value target is fleeing to %1 by convoy. Intel puts him in one of three columns running separate routes, riding in a %2. Find that vehicle and eliminate him before his column reaches the zone.

Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, be advised, we have reports the enemy columns have begun moving towards %1.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, be advised, we have reports the enemy columns have begun moving towards %1.
Key.Chinesesimp: Alpha 1-1，注意，有报告称敌方纵队已开始向 %1 移动。

Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, fresh intel on the enemy columns. Their mid-route points are now marked on your map.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, fresh intel on the enemy columns. Their mid-route points are now marked on your map.
Key.Chinesesimp: Alpha 1-1，关于敌方纵队的最新情报。其中途点现已标注在你的地图上。

Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, we have a track on the enemy columns. Their positions are updated on your map.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, we have a track on the enemy columns. Their positions are updated on your map.
Key.Chinesesimp: Alpha 1-1，我们已追踪到敌方纵队。其位置已在你的地图上更新。

Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, the high-value target has broken from his column and is running for the zone. He's marked on your map.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, the high-value target has broken from his column and is running for the zone. He's marked on your map.
Key.Chinesesimp: Alpha 1-1，高价值目标已脱离其纵队，正逃向该区域。他已在你的地图上标出。

Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, an enemy vehicle patrol is operating near %1. Hunt the column down and destroy every vehicle.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, an enemy vehicle patrol is operating near %1. Hunt the column down and destroy every vehicle.
Key.Chinesesimp: Alpha 1-1，一支敌方载具巡逻队正在 %1 附近活动。追猎该纵队，摧毁所有载具。

Key.Original: Roger. Moving to clear the element.
Key.English: Roger. Moving to clear the element.
Key.Chinesesimp: 收到。正在前往清除该小组。

Key.German: Hier ist Viper 1-5. Wir haben das feindliche Scharfschützenteam lokalisiert — sie tragen Ghillie-Anzüge. Deine Einheit kann handeln! Vorsicht, in ihrer Nähe sind viele Feinde.
Key.Spanish: Aquí Víbora 1-5. Acabamos de localizar al equipo de francotiradores enemigo — llevan trajes ghillie. Tu unidad puede actuar! Ten cuidado, hay muchos enemigos a su alrededor.
Key.Chinesesimp: Alpha 1-1，Allseer 定位到一支正在警戒的敌方狙击手小组，标记于 %1 附近。将其消灭。
Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, Allseer has located an enemy sniper element on overwatch, marked near %1. Eliminate them.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, Allseer has located an enemy sniper element on overwatch, marked near %1. Eliminate them.

Key.German: "Viper 1-5" an Action Squad, gut gemacht! Wir haben bestätigt, dass der feindliche Scharfschütze vollständig eliminiert wurde!
Key.Spanish: "Viper 1-5" a Action Squad, ¡muy bien hecho! Hemos confirmado que el francotirador enemigo fue eliminado con éxito!
Key.Chinesesimp: 致 Alpha 1-1，Allseer 确认敌方狙击手小组已被消灭。干得好。
Key.Original: To Alpha 1-1, Allseer confirms the enemy sniper element has been eliminated. Good work.
Key.English: To Alpha 1-1, Allseer confirms the enemy sniper element has been eliminated. Good work.

Key.Original: Allseer has tracked an enemy recon patrol working this area. Kill them all.
Key.English: Allseer has tracked an enemy recon patrol working this area. Kill them all.
Key.Chinesesimp: Allseer 追踪到一支敌方侦察巡逻队正在本区域活动。将其全部消灭。

Key.Original: Enemy patrols have made camp in the treeline. Destroy every camp.
Key.English: Enemy patrols have made camp in the treeline. Destroy every camp.
Key.Chinesesimp: 敌方巡逻队已在林线扎营。摧毁所有营地。

Key.Original: New tasking Alpha 1-1. Enemy patrols are camped in the area, watching our movements. Wipe out their camps.
Key.English: New tasking Alpha 1-1. Enemy patrols are camped in the area, watching our movements. Wipe out their camps.
Key.Chinesesimp: 新任务，Alpha 1-1。敌方巡逻队正在本区域扎营，监视我方动向。摧毁他们的营地。

Key.Original: Copy that Overlord, moving to clear them out.
Key.English: Copy that Overlord, moving to clear them out.
Key.Chinesesimp: 明白，Overlord，正在前往清除他们。

Key.Original: All enemy camps have been cleared. Good work Alpha 1-1, RTB.
Key.English: All enemy camps have been cleared. Good work Alpha 1-1, RTB.
Key.Chinesesimp: 所有敌方营地已清除。干得好，Alpha 1-1，返航。

Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, Allseer has located an enemy recon patrol in the treeline, marked near %1. Eliminate them.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, Allseer has located an enemy recon patrol in the treeline, marked near %1. Eliminate them.
Key.Chinesesimp: Alpha 1-1，Allseer 定位到一支位于林线的敌方侦察巡逻队，标记于 %1 附近。将其消灭。

Key.Original: To Alpha 1-1, Allseer confirms the enemy recon patrol has been eliminated. Good work.
Key.English: To Alpha 1-1, Allseer confirms the enemy recon patrol has been eliminated. Good work.
Key.Chinesesimp: 致 Alpha 1-1，Allseer 确认敌方侦察巡逻队已被消灭。干得好。

Key.German: Benutze das Scrollmenü, um die Zielposition für den Piloten zu synchronisieren.
Key.Spanish: Usa el menú de desplazamiento para sincronizar la posición objetivo para el piloto.
Key.Chinesesimp: 使用滚轮菜单设置飞行员的目的地。
Key.Original: Use the scroll menu to set the pilot's destination.
Key.English: Use the scroll menu to set the pilot's destination.

Key.German: Bestätigen Sie, dass alle an Bord sind? Synchronisieren Sie die Zielposition mit meinem GPS-Terminal.
Key.Spanish: ¿Confirma que todos están a bordo? Sincroniza la posición objetivo con mi terminal GPS.
Key.Chinesesimp: 大家都上车了吗？在我的地图上标出目的地。
Key.Original: Everyone on board? Mark the destination on my map.
Key.English: Everyone on board? Mark the destination on my map.

Key.German: Lass mich dich im Fahrzeug unterbringen, sei vorsichtig.
Key.Spanish: Déjame acomodarte en el vehículo, ten cuidado.
Key.Original: Let me get you into the vehicle. Easy now.
Key.English: Let me get you into the vehicle. Easy now.

Key.German: "Signal 3-1" an alle Einheiten! Wir wurden an den aktuellen Koordinaten überfallen, schwere Verluste! Ich und ein paar Männer sind in einem nahe gelegenen Gebäude versteckt, wir brauchen dringend Evakuierung!
Key.Spanish: "Signal 3-1" a todas las unidades! Fuimos emboscados en las coordenadas actuales, muchas bajas! Yo y unos pocos hombres estamos escondidos en un edificio cercano, necesitamos rescate urgentemente!
Key.Chinesesimp: 全体单位，我们遭到伏击，伤亡惨重。我们几个人被困在 %1 附近的一栋建筑内。我们需要撤离。
Key.Original: All units, we've been ambushed and have taken heavy casualties. A few of us are holed up in a building near %1. We need extraction.
Key.English: All units, we've been ambushed and have taken heavy casualties. A few of us are holed up in a building near %1. We need extraction.

Key.Original: We copy, Overlord. Moving to Signal 3-1 now.
Key.English: We copy, Overlord. Moving to Signal 3-1 now.

Key.German: "Overlord 1-1" an "Signal 3-1"! Eine Soforteinsatztruppe ist auf dem Weg zu Ihrer Position. Halten Sie durch!
Key.Spanish: "Imperador 1-1" a "Signal 3-1"! Una fuerza de reacción rápida está de camino a tu posición. Resiste!
Key.Chinesesimp: 致 Signal 3-1，快速反应部队正在前往。坚守阵地。
Key.Original: To Signal 3-1, a quick reaction force is en route. Hold your position.
Key.English: To Signal 3-1, a quick reaction force is en route. Hold your position.

Key.German: Action Squad, hier ist "Overlord". Wir haben den Kontakt zu "Signal 3-1" verloren... Verlasse das AO.
Key.Spanish: Action Squad, este es "Overlord". Hemos perdido el contacto con "Signal 3-1"... Retírate del AO.
Key.Chinesesimp: Alpha 1-1，我们已与 Signal 3-1 失去联系。他们被判定阵亡。我们无能为力了。
Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, we've lost contact with Signal 3-1. They're presumed KIA. Nothing more we can do.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, we've lost contact with Signal 3-1. They're presumed KIA. Nothing more we can do.

Key.Original: Alpha 1-1, cordon has been lifted. Evac inbound for Signal 3-1.
Key.English: Alpha 1-1, cordon has been lifted. Evac inbound for Signal 3-1.
Key.Chinesesimp: Alpha 1-1，包围已解除。撤离载具即将抵达 Signal 3-1。

Key.Original: Thanks, Overlord. We owe you for the assist, Alpha 1-1.
Key.English: Thanks, Overlord. We owe you for the assist, Alpha 1-1.
Key.Chinesesimp: 谢谢，Overlord。这份帮助我们记下了，Alpha 1-1。

Key.Original: Signal 3-1, your bird's down and we've nothing else in the air. Exfil on foot, we've got you the rest of the way.
Key.English: Signal 3-1, your bird's down and we've nothing else in the air. Exfil on foot, we've got you the rest of the way.
Key.Chinesesimp: Signal 3-1，你们的飞机已被击落，我们没有别的空中资产了。徒步撤离，剩下的路我们掩护你们。
